formulas.name: ApplicantStatementofEvidenceStatus_DefaultNote
formulas.expression: CASE( {!Applicant_Statement_of_Evidence_Status}, "Received Within Deadline",{!ReceivedWithinDeadlineNote}, "Late Statement Accepted", {!LateStatementAcceptedNote}, "No Statement Submitted", {!NoStatementSubmittedNote}, "Late Statement Disregarded", {!LateStatementDisregardedNote}, "" )

formulas.name: formula_CurrentDate
formulas.expression: TEXT( DAY(TODAY()) ) & CASE( MOD(DAY(TODAY()), 10), 1, IF(DAY(TODAY()) = 11, "th", "st"), 2, IF(DAY(TODAY()) = 12, "th", "nd"), 3, IF(DAY(TODAY()) = 13, "th", "rd"), "th" ) & " " & CASE( MONTH(TODAY()), 1, "January", 2, "February", 3, "March", 4, "April", 5, "May", 6, "June", 7, "July", 8, "August", 9, "September", 10, "October", 11, "November", 12, "December", "" ) & " " & TEXT(YEAR(TODAY()))

formulas.name: formula_DocumentTitle
formulas.expression: 'NW10. Statement of evidence exchange - LO -' & {!Get_Case_Using_recordId.Name} & '-' & TEXT(TODAY())

formulas.name: formula_StatementofEvidenceStatus_Default_Note
formulas.expression: CASE( {!Statement_of_Evidence_Status}, "Statement Received – Sent to Applicant",{!StatementReceived_SenttoApplicant_Note}, "No Statement Received", {!NoStatementReceived_Note}, "Late Statement Accepted", {!LateStatementAccepted_Note}, "Late Statement Disregarded", {!LateStatementDisregarded_Note}, "" )

formulas.name: FurtherRepresentationsNotice_DefaultNote
formulas.expression: CASE( {!Further_Representations_Notice}, "Respond to Applicant's Statement", {!RespondtoApplicantsStatementNote}, "No Applicant Statement – Await Applicant Response", {!NoApplicantStatement_AwaitApplicantResponseNote}, "" )

formulas.name: LateStatementAccepted_Note
formulas.expression: '[[Further to our previous letter dated [[Procedure notice date]] (the procedure notice), your statement of evidence was received after the deadline, but we have decided to accept it. We can confirm that your statement of evidence has been sent to the applicant.]] '

formulas.name: LateStatementAcceptedNote
formulas.expression: '[[Please find enclosed the applicant’s statement of evidence, which was submitted after the deadline, but we have decided to accept it.]]'

formulas.name: LateStatementDisregarded_Note
formulas.expression: '[[Further to our previous letter dated [[Procedure notice date]] (the procedure notice), your statement of evidence was received after the deadline, and we have decided to disregard it. We are therefore returning your statement of evidence to you. A copy will not be sent to the applicant, and it will not be considered by the appointed Inspector and the Secretary of State.]] '

formulas.name: LateStatementDisregardedNote
formulas.expression: '[[We are writing to inform you that the applicant submitted a statement of evidence after the deadline, and we have decided to disregard it. We have therefore returned the statement of evidence to the applicant, and it will not be considered by the appointed Inspector and the Secretary of State.]] '

formulas.name: NoApplicantStatement_AwaitApplicantResponseNote
formulas.expression: '[[As the applicant did not submit a statement of evidence there is no evidence for you to respond to. They have been given until [[Further representations deadline]] to respond to your statement of evidence. We may disregard any further representations received after the deadline.]]'

formulas.name: NoStatementReceived_Note
formulas.expression: '[[Further to our previous letter dated [[Procedure notice date]] (the procedure notice), we note that no statement of evidence has been received from you.]]'

formulas.name: NoStatementSubmittedNote
formulas.expression: '[[We are writing to inform you that the applicant did not submit a statement of evidence.]]'

formulas.name: ReceivedWithinDeadlineNote
formulas.expression: '[[Please find enclosed the applicant’s statement of evidence, which was received within the deadline.]]'

formulas.name: RespondtoApplicantsStatementNote
formulas.expression: '[[You are now afforded the opportunity to respond to the enclosed statement of evidence. Please submit any further representations you have on the applicant’s statement of evidence by 17:00 on [[Further representations deadline]]. We may disregard any further representations received after the deadline.]]'

formulas.name: StatementReceived_SenttoApplicant_Note
formulas.expression: '[[Thank you for submitting your statement of evidence, which was received on [[insert date]]. We can confirm that your statement of evidence has been sent to the applicant.]] '
